According to the Sustainable Direct Recycling of Lithium-Ion Batteries via Solvent Recovery of Electrode Materials paper, the solvent that delaminates cathode films from aluminum foil 'in seconds' without corroding the foil is ethylene glycol (EG).

The research paper states that delamination typically takes a couple of hours to be completed at room temperature, while less than 2 minutes are needed when increasing the reaction temperature to 100°C. At 160°C, delamination takes around 6 seconds. At the boiling point of EG (198°C), delamination takes around 2 seconds.
